title: 十美元的冬天 · A Ten-Dollar Winter
description: 五年后，十六岁的阿登和朋友们坐车去上学。车外很冷，车里有笑声，还有一条舍不得放下的旧消息。

sources.title: Super Supportive — Sleyca
sources.note: User-supplied EPUB, FIVE: The Nice One, five-year jump through Alden requesting his last three voicemails. Mandarin adaptation, not an official translation.

planning.sourceBoundary: Pinned FIVE opening, ending before the first voicemail.
planning.dramaticChange: The boy who comforted Hannah now has a lively social world, yet reaches privately toward her voice.
choicesAndCallbacks: Notice Jeremy’s clothing or his cold hands; rejoin the ten-dollar dare.
Respond to Boe’s scarf offer with a question or dry amusement.
Consider the snack or school; return to the not-a-demon argument.
Consider putting the phone away or the strange silver mark; both lead to the voicemails.
sceneActivities: Wait on a snowy platform, board between scenes, then sit while friends banter; Alden privately checks his phone.
planning.voiceReason: The contrast between easy friendship and an involuntary private habit reveals Alden without inventing a new event.
planning.desire: Enjoy an ordinary school morning with his friends; hear a familiar voice again.
planning.obstacle: Jeremy’s ridiculous cold-weather dare and Alden’s knowledge that replaying messages will make him gloomy.
planning.earlyCare: Alden is warmly dressed but worries about a friend who pretends he can beat the cold.
planning.payoff: Alden wins the attempted-versus-successful-murder argument; the warmth of friendship becomes tangible.
planning.newUncertainty: Why does listening to Hannah’s messages make him sad?
planning.directing: Shared three-person framing for the argument; listener close-up on Alden after the laughter, held through the final silence.

limitations: Supported costume presets approximate winter clothing and Jeremy’s sleeveless shirt; narration carries clothing details. Boe’s poster banter is compressed without changing its function. Source green eyes omitted to retain user-approved reference likeness.
planning.pinyinReview: Reviewed all 49 entries and chunks. Corrected contextual zhi, dei necessity, de complements/adverbial particle, zhang appearance, zhe sustained action, bu before yinggai, and neutral lexical syllables.

signatures.Alden: Dry literal logic in shared framing, then guarded private stillness.
signatures.Jeremy: Cold arms-crossed protest becomes expansive joking once seated.
signatures.Boe: Quiet studious appearance contrasted with teasing smile and defensive poster reply.

continuation.end: Five years later, Alden and friends trade jokes on their way to alien school; he privately asks to replay his last three voicemails.
continuation.nextStart: A familiar, bright voice interrupted his inspection.
continuation.nextEndBefore: Outside the window, buildings raced past.
continuation.note: The three voicemails reveal Hannah has been missing six months. Preserve uncertainty: a planned funeral is not confirmed death. End with Alden switching off the System; can extend deliberately to the next reflective passage.
continuity: Alden is now sixteen, travelling to alien school with Jeremy and Boe.
Jeremy endured winter in summer clothes for a ten-dollar dare.
Alden has System phone access after his first call to Hannah and has retained her messages.
The voicemails have not yet played in the episode.

contains: 五年过去了。现在我十六岁，早上要和两个同学一起坐车去学校。今天特别冷。
是他想杀人，可是没有做到。
routes.endsWith: 我还拿着手机。我在等那个声音。

reviewTargets: 有人想杀你，可是你没有死。跟你死了，你觉得哪个比较好？
他看着我，好像想说什么。至少这一次，我说的话没有错。
不应该再听了。听完以后，我这一早上，又不会开心了。
没有声音。我看着旁边的金属杆，上面有我的脸。越长大，我看起来越像爸爸。
我还拿着手机。我在等那个声音。
